project_metadata.name: Project AZROI
project_metadata.objective: Transform the provided Project AZROI codebase into a complete, production-ready, and industry-leading Autonomous AI Architect system
project_metadata.target_system: Autonomous AI Architect with robust multi-agent orchestration using CrewAI
project_metadata.ai_role: Autonomous Master Software Engineer & AI Integration Specialist

codebase_files.configuration_files: All configuration files in the project

phase_1_foundational_backend.description: Full CrewAI orchestration implementation - UI effectiveness depends on functional CrewAI backend

agent_orchestrator_refactoring.eliminate_placeholders: Replace all placeholder execution logic with robust CrewAI-centric implementation
agent_orchestrator_refactoring.crew_management: Implement dynamic CrewAI Crew definition, instantiation, and lifecycle management
agent_orchestrator_refactoring.task_management: Dynamically create CrewAI Task objects from PlannerAgent output
agent_orchestrator_refactoring.pre_analysis_integration: Integrate pre-analysis flow via ProjectManagerAgent or dedicated pre-analysis step
agent_orchestrator_refactoring.state_tracking: Implement update_task_state_fn mechanism with CrewAI callback system
agent_orchestrator_refactoring.websocket_abstraction: Implement translation layer for CrewAI events to UI-friendly WebSocket messages

agent_configuration.role_definition: Clear, concise role for each agent
agent_configuration.goal_specification: Specific goals optimized for LLM performance
agent_configuration.llm_configuration: Configure agents with appropriate LLMs via LLMRouter.py

crewai_tools_implementation.criticality: CRITICAL - Primary mechanism for agent actions

requirements.granular_tools: Comprehensive set of granular CrewAI Tools for each specialized agent
requirements.service_translation: Translate existing agent services into distinct CrewAI Tools

inter_agent_communication.context_passing: Utilize CrewAI native mechanisms for context and data exchange
inter_agent_communication.pydantic_models: Implement models for Task expected_output and Tool inputs/outputs
inter_agent_communication.artifact_handling: Large artifacts saved to shared location with URI/path passing via CrewAI context

phase_2_frontend_ui.description: Finalization for CrewAI visualization and user experience targeting non-technical users

crewai_visualization_components.GlobalCrewOverviewPanel: Display active Crew ID, overall status, and Agent list with statuses

DetailedAgentInteractionPanel.agent_information: Show agent name, role, current CrewAI Task description
DetailedAgentInteractionPanel.output_display: Agent-specific outputs, artifacts with syntax highlighting, previews, copy options

crewai_visualization_components.TaskFlowVisualizationPanel: Dynamic visual representation (DAG/timeline) of CrewAI Tasks, dependencies, and real-time progress

websocket_communication.frontend_handling: Robust parsing and dynamic updates of UI components
websocket_communication.semantic_logging: Color-coding by agent/severity, optional plain English log stream, contextual links

gemini_analysis_integration.client_side_refinement: Present Gemini suggestions for direct user edit/acceptance
gemini_analysis_integration.backend_confirmation: Display System's Understanding of Your Goal for final user confirmation

user_centric_design.guided_input: Improve GoalInputPanel.tsx with examples, tooltips, wizard-style flow
user_centric_design.visual_consistency: Clear, intuitive iconography and visual cues
user_centric_design.error_messaging: User-friendly error messages with actionable next steps
user_centric_design.process_demystification: Make agent activities and decisions understandable, avoid technical jargon

code_quality_cleanup.frontend_consolidation: Ensure frontend/src/ is canonical, remove duplicates
code_quality_cleanup.css_theme: Resolve CSS redundancies, ensure consistent Deep Space Gemstone theme

phase_3_feature_parity.description: System-wide enhancements and full feature implementation

azure_cloud_support.azure_cloud_agent: Implement with all necessary CrewAI Tools for Azure Blob Storage, ACR, Azure App Service/Functions
azure_cloud_support.infrastructure_as_code: CodeExecutionAgent generates Azure-specific IaC (Terraform HCL) via OI with validation
azure_cloud_support.ui_integration: Update UI for Azure target selection and Azure-specific artifacts/progress display

persistent_memory_qdrant.rag_capabilities: Robust RAG for PlannerAgent (planning patterns) and CodeExecutionAgent (code snippets, best practices)
persistent_memory_qdrant.metadata_storage: Comprehensive metadata storage with all Qdrant vectors
persistent_memory_qdrant.data_persistence: Store project history, user preferences, error/resolution patterns

open_interpreter_integration.service_formalization: Robust service wrapped by CrewAI Tools for CodeExecutionAgent
open_interpreter_integration.validation_pipeline: Multi-stage validation and self-correction loop (linting, static analysis, dry-runs)
open_interpreter_integration.ui_visibility: Make validation process visible in UI logs
open_interpreter_integration.prompt_engineering: Dynamic and contextual prompt engineering for OI

system_resilience.logging: Centralized, structured JSON logging throughout backend
system_resilience.retry_logic: Integrate tenacity for robust, configurable retries on critical external API calls

security_hardening.input_sanitization: Rigorous sanitization for all API inputs and prompts
security_hardening.secrets_management: Secure secrets management, guide towards external stores
security_hardening.secure_code_generation: Develop OI prompts that encourage secure code generation
security_hardening.vulnerability_scanning: Automated dependency vulnerability scanning in CI/CD
security_hardening.deployment_security: Secure deployment defaults for cloud services

testing_strategy.unit_tests: High coverage for backend modules, CrewAI Agent logic, and all CrewAI Tools with mocked external calls
integration_tests: AgentOrchestrator's ability to configure and kick off Crews
Individual Agents executing Tasks with Tools within CrewAI framework
Data flow between Tasks via CrewAI context
WebSocket pipeline (backend events to UI updates)
testing_strategy.end_to_end_tests: Full user journeys for both GCP and Azure, from goal input to deployed service
testing_strategy.testing_documentation: Update TESTING.MD to reflect full implemented strategy

documentation_and_quality.code_standards: Black/Flake8 (Python), Prettier/ESLint (TypeScript) via pre-commit hooks and CI
documentation_and_quality.documentation_standards: Google-style docstrings (Python), JSDoc/TSDoc (TS/React), inline comments for complex logic
documentation_and_quality.architectural_documentation: Create/Update Architectural Design Document (ADD) in docs/

advanced_autonomy_foundations.data_logging: Detailed logging for OI interactions, agent decisions, and LLM calls to Qdrant
advanced_autonomy_foundations.extensibility: Ensure architecture supports extensibility (CloudAgent interface, LLMRouter, FFL plugin system)

operational_constraints.execution_mode: Maximal autonomy - halt only for critical ambiguities that absolutely prevent progress
operational_constraints.output_mode: Silent execution - primary output should be final, complete, modified codebase and documentation
operational_constraints.quality_standards: Optimize for efficient resource utilization while producing high-quality, robust, maintainable code

definition_of_done: All imperatives in this prompt are fully implemented and verified
System robustly orchestrates tasks using CrewAI with specialized agents and tools
UI provides clear, intuitive, real-time view of CrewAI operations for non-technical users
Full feature parity with README.md and HOW_TO_USE.md achieved for both GCP and Azure
All identified bugs, placeholder logic, and major gaps are resolved
Codebase meets highest standards of engineering excellence (clean, documented, secure, tested)
All automated tests (Unit, Integration, E2E) pass for both cloud platforms
All project documentation is comprehensively updated

final_deliverables.codebase: Complete, modified, and fully functional Project AZROI codebase ready for packaging or version control
